text:
Live plants can't be shipped to PO boxes, so the plant will need a street address, such as a home, work or a friend's address. The $20 pot is a non-living item, so it can go to your PO box, but only as a separate order. A mixed order ships together, and that would include the plant.

Standard shipping is $7.95, free on orders of $75 or more after discounts, so a $20 pot ordered alone would pay that fee. Non-living items ship Monday-Friday, and delivery takes 2-8 business days depending on your zone.
